 ALBANY — The latest round of the Home Energy Assistance Program, HEAP, will open on Nov. 2, and this year applicants who rely on fossil-fuel fired furnaces to keep their homes warm will get some extra cash to help offset high fuel prices.
 Eligible low-income New Yorkers can apply through their local Department of Social Services for the program, which will pay directly to the recipient’s utility company to cover part or all of their monthly heating bill. The program can be used to cover most heating bills, and includes provisions to provide assistance to people who pay utilities to their property’s owner or another third-party.
